meta.description: Bends, curls or twists a geometry along the axis it grows on, -z from its base, the way leaf, leaf_surface and instance place a leaf. The amount is read along the geometry with alpha from its base to its tip and, for curl, with alpha across from its middle to its edge, so a curve of alpha says where it bends. Curl and twist before bend, they work on the straight geometry.

geometry.description: A geometry, or a list of them from leaf_surface with variants or a join node. Every geometry is deformed on its own, everything else passes through.

mode.description: Bend arches the geometry up or down along its length, past 90° and into a hook. Curl rolls both halves up or down around lines along it, a grass blade into a channel or the margin of a sage leaf under. Twist turns it around its axis.

amount.description: How far it turns, in turns: a constant amount turns the tip (or for curl the edge) by that much, 0.25 is a right angle. It is read along the geometry as how fast it turns there, so a curve of alpha that is 0 at first bends only the end. Positive bends and curls toward the face (+y), negative away from it, positive twists the edge at +x up.
